//: Pi loads extensions through jiti, so no build step is needed to run them.
This config exists so `tsgo --noEmit` typechecks them like every other
project, and so a mistyped ExtensionAPI call fails here rather than at
extension load with an opaque stack trace.
`typebox` (1.x) is the one TypeBox for the whole repository, so extensions
and application code validate against the same schema objects. Pi's
registerTool() consumes a TypeBox 1.x schema object, which is why the
`extensions/` is Pi's discovery input and contains entrypoints only.
`lib/` holds helpers and `tests/` holds tests, because a module in
`extensions/` is loaded as an extension on every start. tests/pi_loader.test.ts
